title: Multi-timeframe analysis
summary: Use a higher timeframe for the bigger picture and a lower one for detail. Choose them before you look.
unreliableWhen: Timeframes often disagree, and flicking between them until one agrees is cherry-picking. Two timeframes agreeing are two views of the same prices, not two confirmations.
goodExample: Daily uptrend, 1-hour dip: "a pullback inside the daily uptrend so far", with the stop distance taken from the timeframe written in the plan.
badExample: Switching from 1h to 15m to 4h until a chart matches the trade you already wanted.

chart.lookFor: Zoom out to name the trend of the whole chart, then zoom in on the last 20 candles and name what they show. Write one sentence true of both.
